title: Establish canonical Reference Reconstruction Workflow
objective: Make reference-driven scene, generic asset and UI reconstruction a governed KHOSAN Studio workflow with locked visual invariants, targeted repair, uncertainty tracking, QA, independent review and human freeze.
acceptance_criteria: A canonical Reference Reconstruction Workflow document exists
Workflow defines reference package, conditioning, art-direction lock, decomposition, comparison, targeted repair, QA, independent review and Human Approval / Freeze
Workflow records hidden/inferred geometry uncertainty and rejects unsupported 100% fidelity claims
Execution graph routes reference-driven visual work through the workflow without replacing the Character Factory
Asset Pipeline and Master Summary reference the workflow
ASSET-001 backlog contains implementation and verification criteria for the workflow
verification: GitHub fetch verifies all modified canonical files contain the Reference Reconstruction workflow links and routing
GitHub fetch verifies TASK-REFERENCE-RECON-001 and its evidence are valid JSON
risks: This task establishes canonical architecture and backlog criteria; the interactive Reference Reconstruction workspace is not implemented yet
Backend-specific reconstruction workers such as Oriverse remain replaceable and are not made canonical by this workflow
notes: Documentation/state-machine layer accepted. Runtime/UI implementation remains under ASSET-001.
